Hi Elia —

Thanks for applying for the Platform Engineer role at Redwood. I’d love to set up a quick 20-minute phone screen to learn more about your background and walk through next steps.

Are you available for any 20-minute windows next week? If it helps, I can offer:
- Tue Aug 12: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00 CEST
- Wed Aug 13: 10:00–12:00 CEST

If those don’t work, please send 2–3 times that do work for you and include your timezone. I’ve attached the resume I have on file — let me know if there’s an updated copy.

Also attaching a short scheduling link if you prefer to pick a slot directly: https://calendar.redwood.com/slot-scouting

Best,
